key.name: source
key.description: A Todoist filter/project URL or a Todoist filter query.

key.name: filter-language
key.description: IETF language tag used to parse a manually entered Todoist filter query.

key.name: menu-title
key.description: Optional custom title. An empty value uses the saved filter or project name when available.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: One of left, before-clock, after-clock, or right.

key.name: show-count
key.description: Whether to display the loaded task count beside the panel icon.

key.name: spacing-px
key.description: Extra spacing around the panel indicator in pixels.

key.name: complete-on-click
key.description: Whether clicking a task completes it instead of opening it.

key.name: max-menu-items
key.description: Maximum number of tasks shown in the popup menu before a More item is used.

key.name: token-version
key.description: Internal counter used to notify the shell when the stored API token changes.
